PHW.F.1.name: F1. Collect inputs: verified requester, agreement version, grant, request

PHW.F.2.name: F2. Verify the grant with smart-trust-tools against the accepted trust anchor

PHW.F.3.name: F3. Return trust list (DID document, X.509 roots or local list)
PHW.F.3.lane: Trust Anchor (GDHCN or another accepted anchor)

PHW.F.4.name: F4. Check grant status in the Bitstring Status List

PHW.F.5.name: F5. Return status list credential
PHW.F.5.lane: Grant Issuer Status List (W3C Bitstring Status List)

PHW.F.6.name: F6. Fetch the agreement at its fixed-version URL; check SHA-256 and status

PHW.F.7.name: F7. Return DCAT distribution with spdx:checksum and status

PHW.F.8.name: F8. Search active Consents for this agreement [ITI-108] Access Consent: Search

PHW.F.9.name: F9. Return matching Consents [ITI-108] Access Consent

PHW.F.11.name: F11. Receive permit, deny or unknown; hand the decision to audit (process G)
PHW.F.11.lane: Policy Enforcement Point (authorization server, resource server or VHL Sharer)
